verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Wrangler commands for deploying Workers and rolling back to earlier versions. However, nothing describes a single declarative configuration file that defines and versions the whole architecture (bindings, data stores, queues, cron). Deploy and rollback commands are adjacent features and do not show the single-file definition this story requires.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define, deploy, and version my entire architecture with a single configuration file
